source.description: A large brown forest bear standing on all fours, thick shaggy fur, breathing heavily, head swaying slightly, ears twitching. Seamless loop.
The large brown bear attacks — it rears up on its hind legs, then swipes a heavy front paw with claws toward the camera, then drops back onto all fours.
